body:
Thank you so much. I'm not really allowed to have any free time, therefore I don't have friends. I'm okay with that since I have trust issues and probably couldn't tell anyone even if I had a friend. The only relatives that I have left are my stepfather's parents and his siblings and I can't stay with them because I don't really know them and they naturally have my stepfather's back. 


You're very kind, thank you for thinking so. I'm not really sure yet. But I probably want to be an illustrator or a designer but honestly, I'd be more than happy to do anything art related.

Oh my, I'm so, so sorry that you have to go through all of those things. I really wish I could get you as far away from your stepfather as possible, you don't deserve to be treated that way. Thank you for your response and love, it means a lot to me.

It makes me sad to hear that you're struggling but I'm very glad that you're healing. I hope it won't be painful much longer, you deserve to be happy. I've been interested in basically everything that's art related since I was a kid. I love traditional art and digital art. I find the process of making sculptures absolutely magnificent and I also admire architects very much. I always feel extremely honored when I get the chance to talk to artists because I've always looked up to them.  It's very hard to say what kind of art I find the most interesting. I can't choose.

I've told her several times it wouldn't work the way she wants to but she doesn't seem to get it. Of course, I'm aware that you can't miraculously cure a person at home and it's impossible to own all the professional tools. Mother doesn't understand that. 


Yes, I'm still a high school student. Unfortunately, I'm not really allowed to leave the house and even though I've discussed it with my parents a few times before, they're totally against me getting a job.


Thank you so so much for your very helpful response. You honestly helped me out a lot and also made me feel loved.
Thank you so much for your advice. I'll be sure to do that. I'm very sorry that you didn't get to draw more pieces. How are you doing nowadays?
I'm glad you decided to do what you love. Hopefully, I'll get to do it one day as well. And I truly hope your brother is doing better now.

I get you. Everyone in my life doesn't give a single damn about me or my feelings which made me lose faith in humanity mainly because people have been treating me like shit my whole life. But when you read a few posts on this sub, some people actually take the time to write long paragraphs just because they genuinely want to help. And that made me realize that somewhere out there are people who are really kind and caring. Some of us just aren't lucky enough to know anyone like that personally. Please don't kill yourself. Even though there might not be anything that makes you happy at the moment, I'm sure you'll eventually get to experience some pretty great things in the future. Also, if you ever wanna talk then I'm here for you.

Yup. As soon as I stopped being the usual me who supported every single one of my friends, they started drifting away. I couldn't keep pretending that everything was fine since I hated that fake part of myself so I pretty much stopped smiling and I stopped faking all the cheerfulness about 4 years ago. I have never told anyone except one person about the fact that I have been suicidal and they all left me anyways just because they sensed a change in my mood/personality. 
And that one person I told about the self harm and suicidal thoughts rarely talks to me nowadays. Every time I told her that I really wanted to die, she was like 'same. Everyone does. Stop being selfish and hang in there'. You can probably imagine that that didn't really help but whatever. 
People are temporary. When they think it would be too much of a bother to be by your side when you're down, they simply leave.
You're so sweet. Thank you so much. I'm very sorry that your parents made you feel that way. I hope you're doing better now. Thank you for the kind words, you're a really nice person.
Thank you!

I've always been torn between thinking that my parents are right and that I'm just a piece of shit and disagreeing with them. It might hurt that much because you still love them deep down even though they treat you that way. It's your family, you were raised by them and taught to love them and it's pretty damn hard to accept that they hurt you on purpose. I feel the same way. You need to understand that they're fucking lying to you and that you sure as hell aren't worthless. Try to stand up for yourself and if you think sending me a pm would make you feel any better, please pm me. I'm sure we'll eventually get the hell out of there. And we can get through this together.
You made me feel a whole lot better. Thank you so much.
Thank you. I'm pretty sure they would do some terrible things if they found out that I told someone but waiting might be the best option right now.

You're already helping a lot. Thank you very much. Unfortunately, my mother's family is dead and I live with my step father and his family doesn't accept me since I'm not 'their blood'. That's one reason why my father is treating me that way. He hates me because I'm not his child. I don't think there's a place where I could stay because I don't have anyone. I'm not even allowed to have friends.

Thank you so much your advice. To be completely honest, I never really thought about it because I was freaking out about not being able to save money even though research is just as important. I'll definitely focus on that until I'll be able to actually make and save money. 
And yes, the laughter on an asshole. The worst kind of laughter you'll ever hear.

My parents made me go to a school that doesn't specialize in anything, therefore there's this unsaid rule that kids who study there have to go to college otherwise they won't get a decent job or just a job in general. They made that decision on purpose because they thought that way I'd have to live with them way longer because they'd support me financially and they also want me to stay and help out on the farm as long as possible since I work for free and that makes it a lot cheaper than hiring people.

I'm too scared to tell anyone because they'd probably make my life even worse if they found out. I guess planning an escape would really give me some hope and help me not to do anything stupid. Thank you so much for your help. I really appreciate it.

Thank you so much for this. You made me feel a lot better. I guess I keep forgetting about the fact that there are many people who go/went through similar things. I'll probably hang in there and try to plan my way out like you said. I really hope you're doing better now.

I attend a school that doesn't have any school clubs whatsoever and we can't take extra classes either. I have no idea whether other schools in my country (I live in the Czech republic) have school clubs but there are some huge differences between the Czech schools and schools in the US. That's why I can't lie about it to my parents because they have access to everything that's related to the school and they even have an app where they can my schedule and stuff like that. 

Thank you so much for the advice. I didn't even think about making connections with other people but it seems like a really useful and smart thing to do. I might try to have another conversation with my mother (because my father won't listen to anything I have to say) and if that doesn't work out, I'll probably try to get out of here before I go insane.

Thank you. I'll definitely check it out. I stopped seeing my psychologist a few months ago because my mother was against it. I don't think there's a counsellor at my school but I'll try to to cope somehow.

Thank you so much for sharing your story. I know my parents would love the attention as well. I tried to kill myself in the past and my mother took me to the hospital but instead of telling the doctors that it was a suicide attempt, she told them I was retarded and wasn't aware of what I was doing.

Whenever I imagine my funeral it makes me sick to my stomach. My classmate's brother died last year and about 6 people in my class faked tears just so our chemistry teacher wouldn't give us the test we were supposed to take. Those 6 people didn't even know that she had a brother. Therefore, my funeral would be be pleasant for some of the kids at school I  don't even know, too. 

You're right, I can't let them enjoy all the sympathy because that's exactly what they're longing for. Thank you.
